Our Story

Made Fresh,
Every Order

At Star Wok Express, we bring the sizzle of a real wok to every plate. Our recipes balance authentic flavors with the bold, satisfying taste of American-Chinese classics that keep customers coming back.

From crispy egg rolls to saucy lo mein and golden fried rice, every dish is prepared to order and served with pride right here in Webb City.
